speed.previewFrameSteppingHint: Above {{native}}×, preview is frame-stepped and muted. Export is unaffected.

focusMode.autoDescription: Camera follows the recorded cursor position
focusMode.title: Focus Mode
focusMode.lockedDisclaimer: Controlled by the global Auto-Focus toggle in the timeline. Turn it off to set focus mode per zoom.

zoom.selectRegion: Select a zoom region to adjust

annotation.tipTabCycle: Use Tab to cycle through overlapping items.

annotation.title: Annotation Settings
annotation.supportedFormats: Supported formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP
annotation.imageFormatsOnly: Please upload a JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image file.

layout.help: How the webcam is composed with the screen: picture-in-picture, vertical stack, dual frame, mask shape, size, and mirroring.
layout.reactiveWebcamDescription: Camera smoothly shrinks while the video is zoomed in, so it stays out of the way.
layout.helpNoWebcam: This project has no camera, so the layout controls are off and the preset reads “No Webcam”. Your saved layout is kept for when a camera is added.
layout.title: Camera layout

audioTrack.slipHint: Alt-drag to slide the audio inside it
audioTrack.help: Volume, fades and looping for this audio track. It mixes over the recording in the preview and the export. Drag the track on the timeline to move or resize it, or hold Alt and drag to slide the audio inside it.

crop.title: Crop
crop.dragInstruction: Drag on each side to adjust the crop area

transcript.title: Current transcription
transcript.noAudio: This media has no audio track
transcript.noClipTranscript: No transcript for this clip — open the asset card and regenerate.
transcript.help: Aggregated transcript of every clip on the timeline. Backspace / Delete a word or selection to mark it as skipped (red). Hover a red span to restore it.
transcript.whisperHint: Transcribe uses local Whisper — runs on your computer, no data leaves the device.

effects.help: Frame styling for the recording: background blur, drop shadow, motion blur, corner radius, and padding around the video.
effects.title: Composition

captions.derivedFromTranscript: {{count}} caption lines, derived live from the transcript.
captions.hiddenHint: Captions come from this media's transcript. Turn them on to see them in the preview and in exports.
captions.anchorHintTop: Long captions grow downward — the top edge stays put.
captions.translationIsNonDestructive: Translations are stored beside the transcript, never in it — the original text and its timings stay untouched.
captions.anchorHintBottom: Long captions grow upward — the bottom edge stays put.
captions.noTranscript: Captions are read from the media transcript. They turn on once this video has been transcribed.
captions.translateHint: Translate the transcript with the configured AI provider
captions.legacyAnnotations: This project still contains caption annotations from the old captions feature ({{count}}). They render on top of the caption layer.
